onboarding_welcome_intro: Welcome to the Friendolls setup wizard, which will guide you through setting up Friendolls.
onboarding_welcome_description: Friendolls turns your friends into desktop puppets that follow their cursors and appear when they are online.
onboarding_identity_help: Up to 64 characters. You can change it later.
puppet_free_alt: Puppets moving freely across the full viewport
puppet_bottom_alt: Puppets moving along the bottom of the viewport
onboarding_server_skip: If you do not have a server yet, leave this empty and continue. You can add one later.
onboarding_friend_skip: If no one has shared a key with you yet, leave this empty and continue. You can add friends anytime afterwards.
friend_key_verify: Verify this key with your friend before adding it.
accessibility_granted: Accessibility access is granted. Puppets can now follow your cursor.
accessibility_explanation: Friendolls reads the system cursor position so your puppet can follow you and your friends can see that movement. It does not use Accessibility access to read typed text, click buttons, or control other apps.
accessibility_step_enable: Turn on Friendolls in Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
accessibility_step_return: Return here; this wizard confirms the change automatically.
accessibility_settings_opened: macOS opened Accessibility settings. Enable Friendolls there; this page will confirm automatically.
onboarding_complete_body: Click Finish to save setup and launch Friendolls. The control panel remains available from the menu bar or system tray.
account_name_help: This name can be changed at any time.
friends_remove_suffix: . They will immediately go offline and stop receiving your activity.
friends_empty_help: Add someone using their Identification Key.
network_remove_suffix: . Friendolls will stop connecting to it.
network_empty_help: Add a server to connect with friends.
network_existing_connections_stop: . Existing connections through this server may stop.
action_friend_profile_help: Their display name will appear after Friendolls learns their profile from a shared server.
action_friend_verify: Verify with your friend before adding.
action_edit_server_help: Update how Friendolls connects to this remote server.
